text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities analyst Michael J. Freudenstein said he cut his rating on Household International Inc to market performer from buy on price as the stock neared his $85 target price.
-- "Importantly, the fundamentals that led us to recommend the stock initially remain intact and our estimates remain unchanged," Freudenstein said.

"However, we believe that the combination of investors concerns regarding negative industry credit quality trends, coupled with the spectre of higher interest rates make further multiple expansion unlikely in the near term."
-- The stock was up 1/4 at 81-3/8 on Thursday morning.
